- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (high sentiment > 0.7) — reduce forecast peak by 5–10%.
- Underestimate prices in bearish sentiment (sentiment < 0.3) — add 3–7% to forecast to avoid underreaction.
- Overshoot after sharp price spikes — cap forecast 3–5 days post-spike at 10–15% below peak.
- Mean-reversion bias: if 3–5 consecutive days show strong upward trend, reduce forecast slope by 15–20%.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts tend to overreact to short-term sentiment — dampen forecast by 2–5% if sentiment is volatile or recent.
- If sentiment is rising but price is flat or falling, reduce forecast by 3–5% to avoid overconfidence in momentum.
